verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission is a 10-day mission around the moon
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1: 'about nine and a half days. From launch... to splashdown on April 10'; R2: '10-day journey around the moon'; R3: 'approximately 10-day Artemis II mission around the Moon'; R4: '9 days, 1 hour, 32 minutes'
verifications.reasoning: References describe ~10-day lunar flyby (9-10 days), but not precisely '10-day'; broader/less precise terms used.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission marks the first human flight to the lunar vicinity since 1972
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'first piloted moonshot since the end of the Apollo program 53 years ago' (2026-53=1973, Apollo 17=1972); R2: 'first time since 1972'; R4: 'first crewed flight beyond low Earth orbit since Apollo 17 in 1972'
verifications.reasoning: Directly supported as first crewed lunar mission since Apollo 17 (1972).
